Hi Liam,

Great to hear — thanks for sharing the brief. Given your audience is engineering + product, I think we should convert the session from a standard intro demo into a focused engineering scoping sprint (60–90 minutes): short platform overview (10–15m) + hands-on integration patterns, API/ops discussion, and a mutual action plan. Ben (solutions engineer) and Monica (CS lead) should join.

I do have travel booked that week (out of office 7/6 morning → back late afternoon), so the Tue 7/6 10:00am PT slot won't work for me. Ben is available Tue afternoon and Wed morning. Would you be open to: 
- Wed 7/7 9:00am PT (we can do 90m) OR
- Tue 7/6 3:00pm PT (Ben and Monica run -- I can join remotely later if needed)

If you prefer the workshop-style scoping sprint, I'll attach a tentative agenda and we can convert the calendar invite.

Best,
Hannah
